allow: Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_Class -eq ''USB'' -or $_FriendlyName -like ''*USB*'' -or $_FriendlyName -like ''*Serial*'' -or $_FriendlyName -like ''*CH340*'' -or $_FriendlyName -like ''*CP210*''} | Format-Table Status, FriendlyName, InstanceId -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-PnpDevice -PresentOnly | Where-Object {$_.FriendlyName -like ''*USB*'' -or $_.FriendlyName -like ''*Serial*'' -or $_.FriendlyName -like ''*CH340*'' -or $_.FriendlyName -like ''*CP210*''} | Select-Object Status, FriendlyName, InstanceId | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "Get-Process | Where-Object {$_ProcessName -like ''*pio*'' -or $_ProcessName -like ''*python*'' -or $_ProcessName -like ''*serial*'' -or $_ProcessName -like ''*monitor*''} | Select-Object ProcessName, Id | Format-Table -AutoSize")

Bash(powershell.exe -Command "try { $response = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ''http://10.0.0.174/'' -TimeoutSec 5; $response.Content | Select-String -Pattern ''MQTT Settings|Device Info'' -Context 0,3 } catch { Write-Host ''Error:'' $_.Exception.Message }")
